body:
We did not end up with that many requirements into each section in v5.0.be chapter V50.

V50.1 Site Isolation Architecture contains one requirement to declare the architecture expectations and fundamentals that an application can rely on SOP and SameSite at all, but by concept it can be merged into section "V50.4 Browser Origin Separation" 

Potentially we can put "V50.5 Cross-Site Script Inclusion" to the same section as well.

comments.body:
As we will have 2 more requirements into mentioned sections, maybe we need to decide it after those requirements are finalized:
* #2766 
  * It goes to (v5.0.be) V50.3
* #2767 
  * It goes to v5.0.be V50.4 (V50.1 and V50.5 are getting merged into it)
Would love to see V50.1 and V50.4 merged. A agree that V50.5 also seems like a logical merge.

I opened a draft PR for the merge.

Section text must be reviewed - although the point for V50.1 is covered and for V50.5 section text there is not much to cover.

Not sure the section title "V50.4 Browser Origin Separation" is the best one, but at the moment I don't have any other proposals.

For re-ordering section inside V50 I'll open a separate issue/PR in the future.
i didn't see any concerns in the text
I'll close this at the moment, but there is a quite big change that we will have to re-org it more.
